title: Pickup points
description: Local shops that hold your parcels for customers far from a carrier desk. The customer collects with the code on their tracking page and pays the shop, which hands the cash over to you.
handedOver: {parcels, plural, one {# parcel} other {# parcels}}, {amount, number} DA received

empty.title: No pickup points yet
empty.description: Add a superette, taxiphone or bookshop that agrees to hold parcels for your customers.

drop.label: Parcel left at the shop
drop.done: Recorded. The customer now sees the shop and their code.

errors.not_found: This pickup point no longer exists.
errors.parcel_not_found: No parcel of yours has this tracking number.
errors.drop_refused: This parcel cannot go to this shop: it is full or paused, the parcel is already at a shop, or it is delivered or returned.
errors.already_released: This parcel was already handed to the customer.
errors.wrong_code: Wrong code. Ask the customer to read the code on their tracking page.
errors.locked: Too many wrong codes. The parcel is locked; call the customer.

tracking.title: Collect your parcel at this shop
tracking.codeHint: Give this code at the shop. Never share it with someone who calls you.
